name: Saddle Rock-Malibu

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel and Cabernet Franc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot and Zinfandel sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Summers are close to rainless. Vines need irrigation or deep soil that stores winter rain, but disease is rare.

soil.rock: Volcanic rock is porous, so it drains well and sends roots deep. Lava soils are mostly basalt, rich in iron, calcium and magnesium. Gravel drains fast and is poor, so roots go deep for water and food. It holds little water.
soil.top: The topsoil drains well and still stores water for dry spells, so vines grow evenly. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Much of it is steep. Cold air and rain run off, so frost and waterlogging are rare and soils stay thin, keeping yields low. Steep rows are slow and costly to work, often by hand.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
